semanticDecisions: per-element and per-node allocation 0: nodes are ids into int/byte/String/long lanes; the rope value is a facade (arena, root id); summaries are fixed-width long slots per measure
persistent: nodes are never mutated; edits path-copy O(log n) nodes and share the rest; the arena never frees (compaction = rebuild into a new arena); an arena is confined to one thread
coordinates are UTF-16 code units with int lengths as java.lang.String; leaves are coordinate slices of immutable Strings cut to maxLeaf units at admission
seek(metric, k) returns the smallest offset whose prefix size exceeds k; for CODE_POINTS seek(k) - 1 is the offset of code point k
LINES counts CR, LF and CRLF once, also when CR ends one leaf and LF starts the next; WHITESPACE uses Character.isWhitespace per unit (String.strip semantics; no supplementary whitespace exists)
the DFA measure packs T: Q -> Q for at most 16 states in one long and composes T(uv) = T(v) o T(u); it is the REGEX_PRECOMPUTE_DESIGN 2b element, not a regex compiler
